text: Can you get through this page with only a keyboard? Most people can't see the path focus takes. So let's draw it.
This is a demo store, broken on purpose. Every number is a stop on the keyboard path, and every line shows where focus goes next.
Watch. Focus jumps to the footer first, then back to the top. It vanishes into a closed menu you can't see, and lands on buttons with no focus outline at all.
Click any finding to jump straight to it. Each one maps to WCAG, and you can download the full report.
Zero errors. Focus follows the reading order, and every stop is visible.
Three lessons. Tab order follows the DOM. If it can take focus, it must be visible. And never remove the focus outline without a replacement. It's free and open source. The link is in the comments.
